description.value: The business at this address appears to operate as Singapore Hawker Restaurant, an authentic Singaporean and Malaysian hawker-style eatery whose chef brings over 25 years of dedicated experience in these cuisines. The menu is built around bold, shared plates — curries, claypots, satays, and noodles — drawing on both Singaporean and Malaysian traditions. The Burnaby location was recognized on DoorDash's Canada's 50 Most Loved All Stars list for 2022.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record names this business 'Pearl Hot Pot' but the website at singaporehawker.ca belongs to 'Singapore Hawker Restaurant,' a Singaporean/Malaysian hawker-style chain with two Lower Mainland locations. The phone number (+1-604-519-1882) matches the Burnaby location on the website, but the street number differs: OSM says 7154 Sperling Ave while the website says 7150 Sperling Ave. The website confirms takeout and delivery ordering, but makes no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refills, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities.

Address discrepancy: OSM lists 7154 Sperling Avenue, but the website's Burnaby location page states 7150 Sperling Avenue.
No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill) confirmed from website content.
